real_use_case: Create the minimum E1A EvidenceSnapshot after CanonicalGenomicModel by preserving exact versioned ClinVar VCV aggregate and submission-level evidence for each canonical variant.
upstream_status: NCBI ClinVar is continuously updated; each evidence item is pinned by VCV accession.version, retrieval timestamp, exact locator, SHA-256, and byte size external to the repository.
license: ClinVar data are freely available for any use and NCBI requests attribution to ClinVar; real ClinVar XML remains a private runtime fixture and only synthetic XML is stored in the repository.
supported_profile: One exact ClinVar VCV XML snapshot per canonical E1A small variant, bound to GRCh38 display coordinates/alleles and preserving aggregate review/classification plus SCV submissions.
resource_budget: O(total supplied XML bytes plus submissions) time and memory, with a 5 MiB per-record input cap; no network, subprocess, external database, or new dependency inside the capability.
output_contract: MinimumEvidenceSnapshotResult containing ordered per-variant ClinVar evidence items, EvidenceSnapshotMetadata, aggregate classification/review status, condition names, SCVs, conflict state, and exact provenance.
known_issues: ClinVar conflicts are preserved without voting or local consensus. ClinGen/VCEP, ACMG/AMP, gene-disease validity, actionability, population/functional/computational evidence, phenotype matching, and clinical interpretation remain downstream.
security: Rejects unsafe DTD/entity XML, malformed or oversized XML, forged metadata/digests/locators, unverified source-registry metadata, VCV/version mismatches, canonical-variant coordinate/allele mismatches, duplicates, missing evidence, and unexpected cardinality.
disable_path: This capability is not wired to a default pipeline; reject snapshot construction unless every canonical variant has exactly one byte-bound, versioned, variant-matched evidence record and the source contract validates.
